reason: Full independent review against all 4,532 lines of the assigned raw at trusted SHA-256 c11d34a673eab4eeffa090986f9372f6a8f77f644ffd75715f2069d2e3698a8d, CLAUDE.md, rules/ingest.md, rules/psp/metronome.md, the unchanged Campaign 23 Minimum Sufficient Source playbook, the API Mutation lesson, the complete API-wide idempotency authority, and all five proposed concept targets verified candidate/receipt byte equality, suggestions/receipt equality, all five submitted excerpts at their stated raw locations, canonical URL, absent canonical target, and exact path-qualified raw backlink. The candidate accurately preserves supplied-payload required identifiers, open top-level unknown-field behavior, the broad mixed-edit surface and its atomicity/concurrency/recovery unknowns, draft-versus-finalized invoice behavior, recurring-grant eligibility, response identity/detail conflicts, endpoint uniqueness-key versus API-wide header behavior, provider add-only scope conflict, primary contract/invoice/credit/idempotency routes, and a broad raw-detail coverage map. Approval is nevertheless blocked by three material API Mutation defects under the Campaign 23/24 contract. First, the source omits the default-true allow_contract_ending_before_finalized_invoice control, which permits a contract to end before existing finalized-invoice end timestamps while leaving those invoices unchanged unless voided and regenerated; this is a decision-changing contract and invoice lifecycle boundary, not ordinary schema detail. Second, it mentions threshold configurations only as a mutable family and raw schema category, but omits that enabling either spend or prepaid-balance threshold causes immediate evaluation and that reaching the threshold initiates a charge; this is a direct financial side effect. Third, the endpoint snapshot exposes uniqueness_key while the same-date API-wide authority still labels contract-edit uniqueness support coming soon. The candidate and idempotency proposal silently replace that qualification instead of preserving the unresolved documentation/runtime-support conflict. The central provider-scope warning also makes metronome-integrations a primary reciprocal route, but the source omits that concept and the proposed integration update names a nonexistent ## Scheduled provider routing anchor; the current target uses ## Billing-provider transitions. These are material lifecycle, financial, authority/contradiction, and primary-concept defects requiring another full review. The existing endpoint/result and recurring-grant proposals remain accurate; the invoice, idempotency, and integration proposals require correction or expansion.

Carry the boundary into the relevant contract and invoicing shared update coverage and ground it directly.

Add the financially material threshold activation behavior: setting spend-threshold or prepaid-balance-threshold is_enabled from false to true causes immediate evaluation regardless of prior state, and reaching the usage or balance threshold initiates a charge. Keep payment, atomicity, ordering, downstream, and ambiguous-failure outcomes bounded; reflect this fact in the relevant invoicing and credits/commits concept coverage and ground it directly.

Preserve the unresolved idempotency authority conflict instead of replacing it: this endpoint snapshot exposes a 1-128 character uniqueness_key with duplicate-prevention and 409 wording, while the same-date API-wide idempotency page labels contract-edit uniqueness support coming soon. State that documented endpoint exposure does not by itself resolve runtime enablement, keep it distinct from Idempotency-Key replay, and revise the idempotency shared proposal and warning accordingly.

Add metronome-integrations to the source's primary concept routes because the retained provider-scope conflict directly affects that integration decision. Repair the integration suggestion to use the existing ## Billing-provider transitions anchor (or an exact insertion anchor), preserve both add-only endpoint and provider-transition authorities, and keep downstream readiness and reconciliation unproven. Reselect or expand the maximum five grounding excerpts so the new material lifecycle and financial facts are directly evidenced.
